title: Assistant Manager/Manager - MEP Execution
description:
Location: Vizag/Kolkata BE (Mechanical/Electrical/Relevant), with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience Job Description:  Execution Management for all MEP\&T (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing \& Technology (BMS, Access Control, CCTV, Audio\-Visual) works for new projects and retrofits in owned/leased buildings  Manage execution of HVAC System, Electrical System, Plumbing and Fire Systems, BMS System, Access Control System, CCTV \& Security system, for commercial buildings  Understand design intent and ensure execution is in line with design
   

  

  Managing effective coordination and commissioning of various sub\-systems in commercial buildings
   

  

  Quality and Cost Management during execution
   

  

  Safety Management in execution
   

  

  Ensure successful and timely completion of the projects.  Support for LEED and various other green building performance certifications  Support for statutory approvals in line with corporate governance guidelines  Drive innovation and incorporation of latest technologies to produce world class buildings and campuses  Manage other Infrastructure related works
